summary.intent: Clean up unneeded michi worktrees, get all open PRs unblocked (conflicts and CI failures), then audit main thoroughly and fix problems before releasing 0.11.0.
summary.outcome: Removed 4 merged worktrees and ran cargo clean (~13 GB freed); resolved #119's conflict (CI green), closed redundant #124, and the user merged the rest except release PR #131. A three-reviewer pre-release audit found no blockers; the session committed fixes for changesets, stale docs and API leftovers (private fields, NoopProvider removed, must_use) on the fix-open-prs branch, while the pipeline scheduler subagent and the redaction fix were still pending.

repo: Worktree removal for agent-locked worktrees needs a double `--force`; Claude-created worktrees live in `.claude/worktrees/` and `~/.claude/jobs/*/tmp/wt/`.
Entire Gates CI check fails only on an 'Approvals' gate for Dependabot PRs; clearing it needs `entire trail approve michi/<n>`, a human sign-off that auto-mode refused to do on the user's behalf.
The pre-commit hook (`moon format-check`) fails inside the sandbox because it can't lock the shared git config; commits must run outside the sandbox.
`just check` covers fmt, clippy, rustdoc, fuzz-target builds, deny, typos and markdown formatting; `just test` runs ~1,224 Rust tests plus 186 Node tests in about 30s.
Scaling tests retry twice by design in nextest config, so 'flaky' retries there are expected; isolating them would roughly double test time.
Changesets only produce a package's CHANGELOG entry if that package is listed in the front matter; two JS-breaking changesets listed only michi-core and omitted michi-node.
`index.d.ts` is generated and gitignored, so NAPI surface audits must read `#[napi]` attributes in the Rust source.
Removing the `telemetry` module deleted six NoopProvider tests, which accounts for the drop from 1,224 to 1,218 Rust tests.

code.finding: Steps that never started (Skipped(Cancelled) or DeadlinePassed after record_start) still get started_at/elapsed, and the in-task deadline message differs from the one at lines 353-356.
URL password redaction fallback only runs when a quote ends the URL; a raw `<`, `>`, backtick or whitespace ending it first leaves part of the password in clear text.
TruncationOutcome.kept/total_before were pub despite the invariant total_before >= kept.len(); now private with kept()/into_kept()/total_before() accessors and a compile_fail doctest guarding it.
ToonOptions::new hard-coded 200 instead of using DEFAULT_TRUNCATE_CELLS from response.rs:26.

After a root-key collision the text output shows only the error block while JSON still carries sections, budget and provenance (JSON is canonical); this looks intended but is a text/JSON disagreement.

workflow: Subagent reports can be wrong; verifying against the 0.10.0 tag showed the claim that `DomainError::to_call_tool_result` was new was false, so spot-check reviewer claims before acting.
Parallel read-only reviewer subagents (bugs, release notes/docs, API hygiene) while running `just check`/`just test` in the background gave broad pre-release coverage quickly.
Auto-mode blocks irreversible local deletion and approvals made as the user; give the user a copy-pasteable `!` command or ask for explicit OK.
Sandboxed `gh` can fail TLS; read-only retries outside the sandbox work.
A compile_fail doctest is a cheap regression guard for field privacy.

friction: `git fetch` was blocked in the sandbox, so origin/main was stale and PR state had to be read from GitHub.
`gh` TLS failed inside the sandbox and needed a retry outside it.
The auto-mode safety check blocked the first worktree removal, forcing a round trip for user approval.
The pre-commit hook failed under the sandbox due to git config locking.
Auto-mode refused to approve the Dependabot Entire trails on the user's behalf, leaving that to the user.
The first `just check` on the audit branch failed on a doc parse error and needed a fix and re-run.
One subagent finding (to_call_tool_result as new) was factually wrong, costing verification time.
open_items: Pipeline scheduler subagent fixes (started_at/elapsed for never-started steps, unified deadline message, record_start doc) were still running at session end.
Redaction fix for URL passwords ending at `<`, `>`, backtick or whitespace was planned but not shown as done.
Release PR #131 (0.11.0) is still open; merging publishes to crates.io and npm and needs the user's explicit go-ahead, and Callisto may regenerate the body.

Remaining API-hygiene items not done: Rust/NAPI mismatches (items/kvItems totalCount), NAPI missing section/budget/provenance, renderDomainError argument order, and removal of redundant wrappers like render_already_done, renderPipeline, renderStatus and StatusResponse.hints.
Migrate monokl and wisp to 0.11 after release, one session per repo.
About 40 stale local branches remain, and the fix-open-prs worktree holds build output.
The fix-open-prs branch commit has not been shown pushed or opened as a PR.
The reviewer's remaining doc and changeset findings (e.g. response-consistency 'before' comparisons) may not all have been addressed.
